reduce_suppress_p75_entry_volshock_gte_0.physics: Positive entry volshock may make early reduce exits overreact to path turbulence rather than settlement odds.

reduce_suppress_p75_exit_cents_lte_72.physics: Lower exit marks under high p_hold may be underpriced churn where holding recovers value.

reduce_suppress_p75_exit_sigma_gte_110.physics: High remaining sigma at exit means the reduce trigger has more path-noise risk and should need more confirmation before clipping.
